functions.name: ev_poly_pressure
functions.plate: Event type 2 (polyphonic key pressure): ignored.

functions.name: ev_program_change
functions.plate:
Event type 4. Re-resolves the bank from mc->bank_no via the bank table at 0x14080 (built-in 0x3E48 if the address is 0), then if data1 < BankHeader.num_progs sets program, prog = bank+prog_tab[p] and velcurve = bank+velcurve_tab; otherwise restores the old bank pointer.
Quirk: ignores drum_kit (a CC32 drum-kit pointer is replaced by melodic bank bank_no).

functions.name: ev_channel_pressure
functions.plate: Event type 5 (channel pressure): ignored.

functions.name: ev_pitch_bend
functions.plate: Event type 6. bend = (data2<<7|data1)-0x2000 -> mc->bend and scratch 0x14B0. For every sounding voice of the channel: bend_ofs = (bend*range)>>5 & 0xFFFF (range = bend_down if negative else bend_up; 1/256 semitone), then voice_set_pitch (0x14BC) with pitch_mod + bend_ofs + port pitch - 0x8000.

functions.name: ev_system
functions.plate: Event type 7 = MIDI status 0xF0-0xFF (type = status>>4 & 7): ignored. The SH-4 library never sends it (sdMidiSetMes zeroes system messages).

functions.name: ev_control_change
functions.plate: Event type 3. Branch table at 0x1878 indexed by the controller number (128 x 'b handler'); r1 = value&0x7F, r5 = MidiChannel. Handlers: 1 mod, 6 data entry, 7 vol, 10 pan, 11 expr, 20-24/52-56 FLV0-4 ofs MSB/LSB, 25-28 filter EG rates, 32 bank select, 48 MIDI timing counter, 64 damper, 70 filter switch, 71/85 resonance, 72/86 release, 73/87 attack, 74 cutoff, 75 cutoff range, 76 DSP input, 77/78/79 (port 7) DSP out pan/level/effect program, 80 DSP coef preset, 88 decay level, 89 decay rate, 90 (unused), 91 reverb send, 96/97 data inc/dec, 98-101 NRPN/RPN select, 110-117 cutoff x2^0..2^7, 121 reset controllers (whole port). Others (incl. CC0, 120, 123) -> 0x1A78 no-op.

functions.name: cc_ignore
functions.plate: Target of every unhandled controller number (just returns).

functions.name: cc_modulation
functions.plate:
CC1. mc->mod = v; rescales PLFOS/ALFOS of the split's LFO register by (v+1)/128 on all voices of the channel, LFORE cleared.
Quirk: no voice-active test (idle channels with stale port/ch get written too).

functions.name: cc_data_entry
functions.plate: CC6. NRPN selected -> store only (ctl_nrpn_data_set); RPN selected -> falls into ctl_rpn_data_set; else ignored.

functions.name: ctl_rpn_data_set
functions.plate: Stores RPN data (bit7 set) in rpn_data and interprets it using rpn_ref_msb/lsb (+0x20/+0x21) which are never written (CC99/101 write +0x22) -> every RPN is treated as RPN 0: bend_range = v|0x80. 0x7F/0x7F (null) would deselect.

functions.name: ctl_nrpn_data_set
functions.plate: nrpn_data = d. NRPNs are not interpreted.

functions.name: cc_volume
functions.plate: CC7. mc->volume = v, falls into ctl_apply_volume with r6 = expression.

functions.name: ctl_apply_volume
functions.plate: Shared tail of CC7/CC11. level = (curve[a]+1)*(curve[b]+1)-1 >> 7 (curve = 0x3F28). Then for each sounding voice of the channel recompute Voice.vol = (velcurve[vel]+1)*(level+1)*(256-split.tl)-1 >> 14 and TL = 255-clamp(vol + port volume - 0x80).

functions.name: cc_pan
functions.plate: CC10. mc->pan = v (overrides tone pan at note-on); live voices: DIPAN from clamp(v + port pan - 0x80) byte-written to AICA reg 0x24.

functions.name: cc_expression
functions.plate: CC11. mc->expression = v, then ctl_apply_volume (branch into cc_volume's tail at 0x1BA0).

functions.name: cc_flv0_msb
functions.plate: CC20. flv_ofs[0] = v<<7 | old LSB (14-bit, 0x2000 = no change) for FLV0 at note-on; lpoff = 0x7F (filter on).

functions.name: cc_flv1_msb
functions.plate: CC21. flv_ofs[1] = v<<7 | old LSB (14-bit, 0x2000 = no change) for FLV1 at note-on; lpoff = 0x7F (filter on).

functions.name: cc_flv2_msb
functions.plate: CC22. flv_ofs[2] = v<<7 | old LSB (14-bit, 0x2000 = no change) for FLV2 at note-on; lpoff = 0x7F (filter on).

functions.name: cc_flv3_msb
functions.plate: CC23. flv_ofs[3] = v<<7 | old LSB (14-bit, 0x2000 = no change) for FLV3 at note-on; lpoff = 0x7F (filter on). Also refreshes AICA FLV3 of live voices (inline copy of ctl_apply_flv3).

functions.name: cc_flv4_msb
functions.plate: CC24. flv_ofs[4] = v<<7 | old LSB (14-bit, 0x2000 = no change) for FLV4 at note-on; lpoff = 0x7F (filter on).

functions.name: cc_fenv_far
functions.plate: CC25. far_ofs = v>>1 (0x20 = no change), filter EG FAR at note-on; lpoff = 0x7F.

functions.name: cc_fenv_fd1r
functions.plate: CC26. fd1r_ofs = v>>1 (0x20 = no change), filter EG FD1R at note-on; lpoff = 0x7F.

functions.name: cc_fenv_fd2r
functions.plate: CC27. fd2r_ofs = v>>1 (0x20 = no change), filter EG FD2R at note-on; lpoff = 0x7F.

functions.name: cc_fenv_frr
functions.plate: CC28. frr_ofs = v>>1 (0x20 = no change), filter EG FRR at note-on; lpoff = 0x7F.

functions.name: cc_bank_select
functions.plate: CC32 (the driver's bank number; CC0 is ignored). Melodic: bank_no = v, drv_err_flags(0x13420) |= 1 if table entry v has no addr/size. Drum channel (drum_kit bit0): v 0/1 -> bank entry 66/67; if loaded bank_no = v, bank = kit, else bank = built-in kit 0x4124 and error bit 0.

functions.name: cc_midi_timing
functions.plate: CC48. Byte 0x13414 (sdDrvGetMidiTimmingCounter on the SH-4): v==0 clears, else increments.

functions.name: cc_flv0_lsb
functions.plate: CC52. flv_ofs[0] low 7 bits = v; lpoff = 0x7F.

functions.name: cc_flv1_lsb
functions.plate: CC53. flv_ofs[1] low 7 bits = v; lpoff = 0x7F.

functions.name: cc_flv2_lsb
functions.plate: CC54. flv_ofs[2] low 7 bits = v; lpoff = 0x7F.

functions.name: cc_flv3_lsb
functions.plate: CC55. flv_ofs[3] low 7 bits = v; lpoff = 0x7F. Also refreshes AICA FLV3 of live voices.

functions.name: cc_flv4_lsb
functions.plate: CC56. flv_ofs[4] low 7 bits = v; lpoff = 0x7F.

functions.name: cc_damper
functions.plate: CC64. sustain = v&0x40. Down: VOICE_HELD on all sounding voices of the channel (also already-released ones). Up: clear HELD and key off every sounding voice of the channel whose KEYON is clear, held or not (age = 0, ctl&0x3FF|KYONEX - also clears SSCTL), so voices already in release get a second key-off.

functions.name: cc_filter_switch
functions.plate: CC70. lpoff = v: 0 tone LPOFF, 1..63 filter off, 64..127 filter on (note-on only).

functions.name: cc_resonance
functions.plate: CC71 and CC85. q_ofs = v; live voices: Q = clamp(split.q + v-64, 0, 31) byte-written with the current LPOFF.

functions.name: cc_release
functions.plate: CC72 and CC86. rr_ofs = v>>1 (amp EG release, note-on).

functions.name: cc_attack
functions.plate: CC73 and CC87. ar_ofs = v>>1 (amp EG attack, note-on).

functions.name: cc_cutoff
functions.plate: CC74. Jumps through the 9-entry branch table at 0x2284 indexed by cutoff_range (CC75): range 0 and 8 -> x128 (cc_cutoff_k7), range n -> x2^(n-1).

functions.name: cc_cutoff_range
functions.plate: CC75. cutoff_range = min(v,8)*4 (byte offset into the table at 0x2284). Not reset by CC121.

functions.name: cc_cutoff_k0
functions.plate: CC110 (and CC74 via the scale table). cutoff = (v-64)<<0, then ctl_apply_flv3.

functions.name: cc_cutoff_k1
functions.plate: CC111 (and CC74 via the scale table). cutoff = (v-64)<<1, then ctl_apply_flv3.

functions.name: cc_cutoff_k2
functions.plate: CC112 (and CC74 via the scale table). cutoff = (v-64)<<2, then ctl_apply_flv3.

functions.name: cc_cutoff_k3
functions.plate: CC113 (and CC74 via the scale table). cutoff = (v-64)<<3, then ctl_apply_flv3.

functions.name: cc_cutoff_k4
functions.plate: CC114 (and CC74 via the scale table). cutoff = (v-64)<<4, then ctl_apply_flv3.

functions.name: cc_cutoff_k5
functions.plate: CC115 (and CC74 via the scale table). cutoff = (v-64)<<5, then ctl_apply_flv3.

functions.name: cc_cutoff_k6
functions.plate: CC116 (and CC74 via the scale table). cutoff = (v-64)<<6, then ctl_apply_flv3.

functions.name: cc_cutoff_k7
functions.plate: CC117 (and CC74 via the scale table). cutoff = (v-64)<<7, then ctl_apply_flv3.

functions.name: ctl_apply_flv3
functions.plate: For each sounding voice of the channel: AICA FLV3 = split.flv[3] + flv_ofs[3]-0x2000 + cutoff, clamped to 8..0x1FF8 (only bits 15:13 of f+8 tested). Same code inlined in CC23/CC55.

functions.name: cc_decay_level
functions.plate: CC88. dl_ofs = v>>1 (amp EG DL, note-on).

functions.name: cc_decay_rate
functions.plate: CC89. dr_ofs = v>>1 (added to D1R and D2R at note-on).

functions.name: cc_90
functions.plate: CC90. cc90_ofs(+0x3A) = v>>1; never read by the driver.

functions.name: cc_dsp_input
functions.plate: CC76. isel = (v&0x70) ? 0x7F (tone ISEL) : v&0xF (DSP MIXS input for new notes).

functions.name: cc_dsp_out_pan
functions.plate: CC77, port 7 only: EFPAN of DSP output slot ch (byte at AICA 0x2000+ch*4) = MIDI pan conversion of v.

functions.name: cc_dsp_out_level
functions.plate: CC78, port 7 only: EFSDL of DSP output slot ch (byte at AICA 0x2001+ch*4) = v>>3.

functions.name: cc_dsp_program
functions.plate: CC79, port 7 only: v != 0 -> fx_prg_select(v-1) (0x5C98); v == 0 -> fx_prg_clear (0x5DCC). Same as host cmds 0x84/0x85.

functions.name: cc_fx_dsp_pan
functions.plate: CC80 (any port): pan of DSP effect slot ch. If the effect program has pan slots (fx_pan_mode: bit4 = 8 slots stride 8, else bit5 = 4 slots stride 4), copies equal-power preset v>>2 (4 gains, fx_pan_coef_tab 0x3C48) to COEF[fx_pan_coef_base + (ch&7 or ch&3) + k*stride]. Same as host cmd 0x88 for one slot.

functions.name: cc_reverb_send
functions.plate: CC91. v != 0: fx_send = 2v; live voices IMXL = clamp((2v>>4) + port fx_send ofs) with the tone ISEL (CC76 override lost). v == 0: fx_send = 0 and live IMXL forced to 0 (tone IMXL + port ofs - 0x20, carry-based clamp, then 'and r1,r1,#0' bug; new notes use the tone IMXL).

functions.name: cc_data_inc
functions.plate: CC96. NRPN selected: nrpn_data+1 (adds on a byte never carries: 0xFF wraps to 0). RPN selected: 'add' without S, so 'movcs r1,#0xFF' tests the stale C flag left by midi_event_pop's 'cmp write,read' (nothing in between changes C): C set (ring not wrapped, the usual case) -> value is 0xFF outright, so bend_range becomes 0xFF (127 semitones); C clear -> rpn_data+1. Then ctl_rpn_data_set.

functions.name: cc_data_dec
functions.plate: CC97. NRPN: nrpn_data = max(v-1,0)|0x80. RPN: BUG - decrements nrpn_data's value (r1 still = +0x24) and stores it through ctl_rpn_data_set.

functions.name: cc_nrpn_lsb
functions.plate: CC98. param_lsb = v; nrpn_data|=0x80, rpn_data&=0x7F. The stored number is never used.

functions.name: cc_nrpn_msb
functions.plate: CC99. param_msb = v; nrpn_data|=0x80, rpn_data&=0x7F. The stored number is never used.

functions.name: cc_rpn_lsb
functions.plate: CC100. param_lsb = v; rpn_data|=0x80, nrpn_data&=0x7F. The stored number is never used.

functions.name: cc_rpn_msb
functions.plate: CC101. param_msb = v; rpn_data|=0x80, nrpn_data&=0x7F. The stored number is never used.

functions.name: cc_reset_all
functions.plate: CC121. Resets controllers of ALL 16 channels of the port (r6 = channel 0): vol/level 100, expr 127, isel 0x7F, pan 0xC0, q 0x40, EG ofs 0x20, flv_ofs 0x2000, cutoff/bend_range/bend/mod/lpoff/sustain/fx_send 0. Keeps program/bank, RPN state, drum_kit, cutoff_range. Then every sounding voice of the port loses VOICE_HELD; released ones are keyed off.

functions.name: ctl_reset_port
functions.plate: Unreferenced alternative entry of cc_reset_all: r6 = 0xC400 + (r0&7)*0x480, then b 0x27B4. Does not set r3, so the voice loop uses a stale port.

labels.name: cc_branch_table
labels.comment: 128 x 'b handler', indexed by CC number

labels.name: cc74_scale_table
labels.comment: 9 x 'b cc_cutoff_kN' indexed by cutoff_range (0..32 step 4): 7,0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7

LSR of signed product; only low 16 bits kept (== ASR)
voice_set_pitch(r5 voice, r6 split, r7 pitch, r8 AICA ch)
NB: no voice-active test in this loop
drum channel? (drum_kit bit0, set by host cmd)
EFPAN of DSP output slot ch
EFSDL of DSP output slot ch

Branch table for CC74, entered with 'mov pc, 0x2284 + cutoff_range'. Entries: range 0 -> k7, 4 -> k0, 8 -> k1 ... 28 -> k6, 32 -> k7. Followed by nop padding.
